raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for your inquiry. We understand that there may be some confusion regarding the current status of your project. To ensure we provide the best support, could you please clarify whether the project is currently paused and if there are any disagreements about the requirements? This will help us better align with your needs and proceed accordingly.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Cedar Systems
[Contact Information]
